title: Legacy program rumored to lure UFOs with psionic assets

tellings.quote: There are rumors that the legacy UFO program itself uses protocols to attract UFOs to come in.

plain: The legacy UFO programme, a secret effort said to hold recovered craft, is rumored to use 'protocols to attract UFOs to come in', relying on people said to have psychic powers. Michels repeats this himself as a rumor, without naming a source, in an episode about a man NASA studies because UFOs are said to appear around him.
